Quick tech playbook (minutes -> hours):

- Immediate (0–15m):
  * Route throttle: apply lossless throttles to analytics routes (reduce QPS by ~55% to free headroom).
  * Priority routing: bump checkout route to high-priority lane so KV cache is favored.

- Short horizon (15–60m):
  * Enable prefix/KV caching (we estimate 18–25% token reduction on repeated prompts).
  * Model fallback: switch low-latency checkout route to quantized 7B variant — expected p95 reduction ~120–160ms; CPU/GPU utilization drops by ~28%.

- Medium (1–6h):
  * Authorize burst +20% on Verve's Dedicated pool. We will route burst to adjacent healthy nodes in the same region; fallback policy remains the quantized variant.
  * Temporarily deprioritize background batch jobs; schedule catch-up overnight.

Expected net: p95 should trend back toward baseline within 20–40 minutes of the immediate+short changes; 5xx should fall to <0.5% after the model fallback and caching.

Attachments: mitigation_playbook.md, cost_estimates.pdf

I'll push configuration changes to the blue environment (no service restart). ETA for initial throttles + KV enable: ~12 minutes from now. ETA for model-fallback routing rollout: ~28 minutes.

—David
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
